title: Balanced Adaptive Prototype Selection for Scalable TabPFN Inference on Large-Scale Tabular Data
abstract: arXiv:2608.12989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Pretrained tabular foundation models have demonstrated strong predictive capability; however, their application to large-scale datasets remains constrained by the limited inference context. This paper introduces Balanced Adaptive Prototype Selection (BAPS), a framework for constructing compact, information-preserving contexts for scalable TabPFN inference. Without modifying or retraining the pretrained model, BAPS jointly preserves representative structure, informative decision boundaries, local density, class balance, and feature-space diversity. Experiments on the million-row HIGGS and SUSY datasets show that 512 prototypes retain strong predictive performance and reliable calibration, corresponding to an approximately 1,953-fold context compression. translated_title: 面向大规模表格数据可扩展TabPFN推理的平衡自适应原型选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12989v1 公告类型：新 摘要：预训练表格基础模型已展现出强大的预测能力；然而，它们在大规模数据集上的应用仍受限于有限的推理上下文。本文介绍了平衡自适应原型选择（BAPS），一种用于构建紧凑且信息保持的上下文框架，以实现可扩展的TabPFN推理。在不修改或重新训练预训练模型的情况下，BAPS联合保留了代表性结构、信息性决策边界、局部密度、类别平衡和特征空间多样性。在百万行HIGGS和SUSY数据集上的实验表明，512个原型能保持强预测性能和可靠校准，对应约1953倍的上下文压缩。所有实验均在配备16 GB RAM且无GPU加速的Intel Core i7 CPU上进行。这些发现确立了有效的上下文构建作为扩展预训练表格模型实际应用范围的实用机制。
tldr: 提出BAPS框架，通过平衡自适应原型选择在不修改预训练模型的情况下实现大规模表格数据的高效压缩推理，达到约1953倍上下文压缩并保持预测性能。
en_tdlr: BAPS framework enables scalable TabPFN inference on large-scale tabular data via balanced adaptive prototype selection, achieving ~1953x context compression without model modification.
